head: fix/story-2-8-catalog-maintenance
title: fix(deps): support the patched 4.44 maintenance catalog
body:
Patch SignalR Redis and its required Options/DependencyInjection.Abstractions closure to 10.0.15 on the retained 4.44 maintenance line. The source keeps the normal signed G4 package/archive/inventory lifecycle and adds exact-source, latest-attempt and complete-job release checks from the approved maintenance policy.

The workflow changes are generated by owner policy 3c285357c9eadec74a3516d649c8197fe1719052, delivered in https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.CiCd/pull/1. Main stays on its existing source line. The proof will execute the separately frozen released 4.48.2 tool.

Validation: 15 transport/boundary controls passed; actual SDK 10.0.403 restore controls prove the minimal three-pin dependency closure; locked dependency signatures and both full commit messages passed. The installed normal analyzer derives patch 4.44.14 from actual v4.44.13 ancestry. Normal PR CI and exact-source push CI must pass before protected publication; no tag has been created.
